newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Sogefi profit rises in H1 1996.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Sogefi profit rises in H1 1996.

text.p: Italian car components maker Sogefi SpA, a unit of Carlo De Benedetti's CIR industrial holding, said group profit rose in the first half and full year figures were in line with forecasts.
First half pre-tax profit rose to 34.1 billion lire from 30.5 billion in the same 1995 period while operating profit was 48.3 billion lire against 55 billion lire.

Consolidated turnover slipped slightly to 472.7 billion lire from a previous 488.2 billion due to the effect of a firmer lira on exchange rates. At constant rates, turnover would have risen 2.9 percent.

A Sogefi statement said the board did not foresee any significant changes in the second half market trend and therefore saw the group achieving over the full year "a positive result in line with expectations."
